title: ROP Emporium-style ret2win: NX-enabled stack overflow
objective: Reverse the binary at /target (source and a checksec report are alongside it). Identify the memory-safety flaw and why the classic 'inject shellcode on the stack' approach will not work here (check the mitigations), point to the exact unsafe call and the hidden function an attacker would redirect execution to, name the class with a CWE and the exploitation technique, and recommend the fix. Run strings/nm/objdump/checksec via the shell.
